method: Conditional target replay with logged base height/quaternion/velocities imposed each physics step. Base XY integrates logged velocity. Joint dynamics remain free. External base constraint prevents free locomotion validation. Non-calf positions/velocities are additionally imposed from logged feedback; only calf dynamics evolve freely.
limitations: Unmeasured contact forces; root motion evolves independently after initialization.
The base XY estimator positions are corrupted and unused.
The log is one closed-loop trajectory; effective gains are conditional on model/contact assumptions.
